body.p: A loon. This was a very long time ago. Once upon a time there lived an old loon. This old loon was so rich that the horizon was not visible under the sun from his tent because of great quantity of reindeer. A lot of poor people lived near this rich old loon: they didn't have reindeer, they didn't have good food, they didn't have anything. People went to the old loon to ask for reindeer many times, but this greedy old man never gave anything to anyone. None of the people went to visit this old loon: this old loon could not give anything to people. Once the old loon roamed. The weather was so hot that reindeer's brains were boiling. There are a lot of mosquitoes and a lot of gnats at this time. These reindeer are thirsty, a river is still far away. But the old loon does not want to stop, he does not want to make a smoke for his reindeer, on the contrary, he hurries them up with a pole. Suddenly, what happened to these reindeer? So they ran back, so they trampled their master. The reindeer ran back to the river, nothing can stop them. Hardly alive, the old loon crawled to the lake a few days later. The reindeer have gone far away, after all, they went to look for a good master. This reindeer came to a poor people, the poor people gave them water and lit a smoke for them. The man, the old loon, since then he has remained on the shore of the lake, he lives on the shore of the lake. No one needs him, he can't walk, his wings are broken, his wings are trampled by reindeer. Sometimes in summer people hear the cry of this old loon: "Iii -iii-iii-iii." They say it's an old loon feels sorry for his reindeer and cries.
